newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf to push on in UK without Murphy.
newsitem.headline: Elf to push on in UK without Murphy.

text.p: French oil group Elf Aquitaine said on Thursday the withdrawal of Murphy Oil Corp from a British refinery merger plan would not stop Elf pressing ahead with the other partner Gulf, part of Chevron Corp.

An Elf spokeswoman at group headquarters in Paris confirmed Elf planned to push ahead with Gulf at around the same time as Elf British unit Elf Oil UK Ltd said Murphy's withdrawal simply restored what had been the original plan, a combination of Elf and Gulf.
She said the two companies hoped to sign an agreement on the British merger in the second half of 1997.

"Murphy's decision, based on considerations which concern (Murphy unit) Murco Petroleum Ltd itself, does not call into question Elf's and Chevron's determination to get an agreement signed during the second half of 1997 to create a joint venture regrouping their assets in Britain," she said.
Murphy announced earlier it was withdrawing from a planned merger in refining and marketing in Britain between its Murco Petroleum Ltd and the Elf and Chevron units.
